description: Proposes a new commit for a line of config/zsh/pins.zsh when the branch it names has moved. Nothing else in the repository is Renovate's to update.

customManagers.description: One pin per line: repository on GitHub, commit, and the branch that commit is on.

packageRules.description: One pull request a week for all of them. The plugins move every few days between them, and each change is a diff somebody has to read.
